name: Telkibánya (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, yellow at the hoist and green at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Telkibánya (a shield with a castle tower and crossed hammers, with mantling) above the words TELKIBÁNYA 1487 in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
